text:
Sam (People Ops): quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A — thanks for the great questions earlier. dropping a short FAQ + next steps on promos, comp, and a couple benefits items folks asked about. :memo:

Liam (Head of Eng): great, managers need the short answers for 1:1s.

Noor (Manager): can we get exact cutoffs? and how to handle someone who just missed probation?

Sam (People Ops): dates: self-reviews close 2026-06-07 EOD PT. manager reviews 2026-06-09 -> 2026-06-15. calibration block 2026-06-16 -> 2026-06-18. appeals/retro window 2026-06-19 -> 2026-06-24.

Noor (Manager): thanks. new hires in probation?

Kai (People Ops): standard: wait one cycle. exception: EM documents >2x expected ramp + measurable impact; submit the hire-exception form and tag Recruiting + People Ops. we’ll fast-track.

Liam (Head of Eng): off-cycle raises — what's the approval chain?

Sam (People Ops): off-cycle raises allowed for retention or scope change. flow: Manager -> Director -> People Ops; >5% comp change adds Finance. use the Adjustment form (intra link). try to limit off-cycle cases to maintain fairness.

Ivy (Benefits): parental leave/benefits note: parental leave policy unchanged; eligibility tied to hire date. open enrollment for perks stays in Nov.

RecruitingBot: Reminder: include offer comparator and market notes when nominating external hire adjustments.

Noor (Manager): any guardrails on off-cycle promos (percent of org)?

Kai (People Ops): fairness guardrail: aim for <6% off-cycle promos per org. People Ops may push to cycle if exceptions spike.

Sam (People Ops): retro pay: payroll processes retro on next payroll after approval; expect 1-2 pay cycles delay. please attach approval timestamps to retro forms.

Liam (Head of Eng): can we get a manager justification template to paste into review notes?

Kai (People Ops): yes — paste this into the form or notes:

``nCandidate: <name>
Current title/band: <title>
Requested title/band: <title>
3-line rationale: impact / scope / customer/org outcome
Manager summary (2 sentences): readiness + expected milestones
Requested comp change: <none / % / band move>
Attachments: PRs / postmortems / customer feedback
Approvals: Manager / Director / People Ops / Finance (if >5%)
```

Noor (Manager): perfect. last ask: how long till changes reflect in equity refresh?

Ivy (Benefits): equity refreshes are modeled at grant time and are separate approvals. if a promo includes equity, Finance will model value; grant timing usually next scheduled grant (quarterly).

PayrollBot: Office hours reminder: People Ops calibration Q&A — 2026-05-18 16:00 PT.

Sam (People Ops): we'll post the cheatsheet + links in #people-ops-resources and pin it. office hours tomorrow 4pm PT — bring cases. DM Kai for sensitive escalations. :white_check_mark:
